source_title: Ranbir reunites with 'YJHD' co-star Poorna at 'Ramayana' premiere
source_excerpt: Ranbir Kapoor reunited with his 'Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani' co-star Poorna Jagannathan at the Los Angeles premiere of 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend'. The actress, who played Riana Sarai in the 2013 romantic drama directed by Ayan Mukerji, shared a picture with Ranbir on her social media handle, giving fans a glimpse of their reunion backstage, more than a decade after their film together.Poorna, posted the picture on Instagram, posing alongside Ranbir, who essays the role of Kabir 'Bunny' Thapar in the film. The photograph from the premiere has since caught the attention of fans, who were delighted to see the two actors together again. She also added the song 'Ilahi' sung by Mohit Chauhan, to the post.She also shared a photo from inside the theatre and posed for a photo in front of the film's poster that featured on the big screen.Poorna made headlines last year, when she got candid about facing ageism in Bollywood. The actress, who starred in Abhinay Deo's 2011 film 'Delhi Belly', said she found it difficult to get roles. "I did 'Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani' but I just felt underestimated. There was just no role for me. There was intense ageism in the industry when I was there. Things have really shifted. Priyanka, Deepika and all these people are really shifting what it means to be a woman in their forties, but not when I was there. I felt like I would've loved to have worked more, but it just didn't happen."The Los Angeles premiere of 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' took place at the David Geffen Theatre inside the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on October 27. The special screening was attended by the film's lead cast, including Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash, along with director Nitesh Tiwari and producer Namit Malhotra. Several international celebrities, including Jada Pinkett Smith, attended the screening.Ranbir plays Lord Rama in the ambitious two-part epic, with Sai Pallavi portraying Sita and Yash taking on the villainous role of Ravana.
